TxConfirmations has been added.

elements
2014-03-31
4.1.3
AUTOSAR
Release
Management
• Clarified meaning of FrArTpTc
• Clarified requirements for sending
FC(OVFLW)
• Revised routing path const correctness
• Harmonization of API descriptions
2013-10-31
4.1.2
AUTOSAR
Release
Management
• Retry of FrIf_Transmit mechanism
has been removed in case this API
returns E_NOT_OK
• Removed FRARTP prefix for fields of
FrTp frames and used camel case
notation consistently for EcuC
parameters
• Removed NotifyResultType from
ComStackTypes and replaced by
Std_ReturnType in the APIs
• Removed the ’Timing’ row from the API
table(s) of chapter ’Scheduled Functions’
• Editorial changes
• Removed chapter(s) on change
documentation
